grounding.observation: 27 isolated crowd and actual rear/crowd frames inspected. Cuff, crown and sash contacts remain failures, not polish. Existing27 evidence is frozen.
grounding.comparison: Original direction and supporting film floor remain binding.

expert_coverage.observation: Final evaluated geometry, actual wrist clearance and local head-to-cloth transform address the specific contact causes.
expert_coverage.comparison: Material reduction is separate from structural repair.

film_alignment.observation: Retain indigo/ochre and donor identity; reduce the excessive noise rather than equate texture quantity with quality. Include trousers to avoid separate-material toy appearance.
film_alignment.comparison: Accepted Pashtun remains the reference, not27.

preferences.observation: No Director technical gate and no cast propagation before representative proof.
preferences.comparison: Shared allowance remains bounded; no arbitrary readiness claim.

reference_roles.observation: Reference rear is choreography authority, Pashtun film floor,27 actual failure evidence.
reference_roles.comparison: Native return cannot replace these distinctions.

method.observation: Fit sash to evaluated subdivided cloth, retain source pose binding and apply final support after smoothing. Cuff moves18mm along actual standing forearm. Crown uses ray hits in its own actual head frame with bounded displacement.41 focused tests pass.
method.comparison: Closest-surface correction can still distort at the shoulder/waist and must be viewed.

interfaces.observation: Original hand/head geometry, actors and four protected motion owners are unchanged. Crown modifiers and rendered wrist/waist must be checked, not just input coordinates.
interfaces.comparison: Actual front/reverse and rear poses required; no contact waiver.

efficient_quality.observation: Still two actors only. Render diagnostic and actual shot-scale frames before remaining work is assigned.
efficient_quality.comparison: Do not spread a failed representative to improve a distant crowd screenshot.

authority.observation: 28/max29, ninth of ten newly authorized corrections; one appearance cycle remains and no unallocated reserve. Existing motion allowance separately retained.
authority.comparison: No spend, install, upload or expanded identity authority.

strongest_counterexample: A final closest-surface modifier could reintroduce serration or move the sash around the wrong surface; crown fitting before final vertical shaping may still leave a small collision. The actual images, not the guards, decide. If this remains inadequate, retain failure and reassess the representation within the last allowance.
